PulseChain thesis: three-round comprehension and evidence
study
30 September 2026. The reviewed edition describes a conditional price-support mechanism. This study
records that edition's review method, findings and reproduction references. Its frozen inputs identify the
exact text assessed; subsequent editorial revisions of the maintained thesis (main paper) are outside
these three rounds. All blockchain work was read-only.
Method and scope
Five AI reviews assessed protocol accounting, bridges and token delivery, economics, clarity, and
evidence reproduction. Each completed three rounds. Each report included five simulated audience
perspectives: an Aave/Solidity engineer, a DeFi liquidity provider, a finance professional without
blockchain experience, a general reader without blockchain experience, and a beginner familiar with
wallets. That is 15 reports and 75 simulated audience assessments. No human participants were
recruited; these results cannot measure actual reader comprehension or establish universal
understanding.
First-round reviews received the frozen paper without prior conversation and recorded a teach-back
before consulting evidence or other reports. Later rounds were informed rereadings of revised inputs by
the same reviews. Shared records and AI-generated reader responses limit independence. Each
assessment asked what changes hands, what finances purchases, what settlement requires, which
callers have authority, and what supports a dollar quote. Reports included likely errors, questions,
answers and concrete edits, rather than invented human pass scores.
The paper was revised after every round. Frozen inputs, reports and final documents are retained in the
review batch; their SHA-256 hashes and word counts are recorded in the experiment manifest. The first
input contains 6,099 whitespace-delimited words; the final thesis contains 2,994. Three diagrams show
the purchase cycle, separate Portal/debt allocations, and stablecoin pool connections. Their syntax and
financial meaning were reviewed; no rendered-image compatibility test was performed.
Findings
The reviews found a coherent conditional mechanism: repeated accepted inputs can finance local
accumulation when an exact-token delivery and funded conversion remain usable. Retained inventory
can meet buying demand, while executable bids can support selling. Holding most tokens strengthens
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 451

influence but does not itself establish dollar coverage. A fluctuating payment asset requires changing
payment quantities and revaluing executable coverage against inventory sellable over the declared
horizon.
The most consequential accounting distinction is between trade receipts, receipts burned against the
borrower's debt, and outstanding Portal principal. One unit cannot serve both allocations. Debt
repayment does not create reserve cash or settle Portal exposure. The inspected backing method also
requires a currently Bridge-authorized caller, matching underlying, allowance and supplied fee. Income is
one possible settlement source; its modeled multi-year horizon is not a protocol maturity. Acquired
assets, outside earnings, expenses and settlement commitments must be accounted for without
counting nested receipts or controlled-account fees twice.
The authority checks distinguish immediate acceptance of the observed executor nomination from the
subsequent one-day configuration queue. They identify the borrower's reported owner and the HubPool
owner, but do not prove arbitrary borrower execution, common private-key control or every rollup-owner
role holder. Published UpgradeExecutor delegatecall authority is broader than ordinary role grants. Portal
permission does not confer issuer rights over underlying tokens. The map lists observed addresses,
required changes and unresolved controls.
Audience simulations repeatedly exposed confusion between a receipt and cash, LP locking and
protection from swaps, a restored marginal price and a completed seller's proceeds, and token parity
and dollar value. The revised examples and diagrams make those distinctions explicit. They preserve the
adverse network result: repeated local support pushes the surrounding modeled U asset down to
0.694741 rather than keeping the whole network at one dollar.
Evidence and reproduction
The reproduction review reran four existing offline calculations and obtained JSON objects identical to
the preserved results: liquidity growth, coordinated network support, deferred campaign/debt
accounting, and Portal pricing. The first reproduction report identifies each script and result file. The
economics review separately checked key V2, StableSwap, cadence and yield calculations. These checks
reproduce arithmetic from saved evidence; they do not execute the proposed campaign.
Three additional fixed-block authority batches contain getters, contract-code reads and storage reads.
Published source and proxy slots support the authority map, with explicit limits: not every dependency
was independently compiled and matched to runtime bytecode. Older Atropa, pricing and validator
snapshots retain their own block numbers. Incorrect raw getter labels and initial wrong-signature Across
responses are identified in the reports and excluded from the relevant claims; frozen records are
preserved.
Review strand Round 1 Round 2 Round 3
Protocol Report Report Report
Bridges Report Report Report
Economics Report Report Report
Clarity Report Report Report
Reproduction Report Report Report
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 452

Remaining proof requirements
The operating source environment, exact integrations, campaign-scale output, some account execution
and issuer rights, dollar reference, funded support policy, and Ethereum exit remain unverified or
unspecified. The final reports support the conditional explanation after their small clarifications; they do
not certify a flawless deployment, perpetual peg or real-human comprehension. Final copy edits were
applied after round three and checked locally; they were not presented as an additional blind review
round. Earlier releases remain frozen.
